thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: stream-service.p95 > 350ms for last 10m in eu-west-1 (anomaly score 8.7). Paging @devon oncall.

devon: on it. seeing the p95/p99 spike too. starting a triage. any recent rollouts?

anya: flagged a TRT8/flashattn variant rollout ~09:12 UTC to a subset of hosts in eu-west-1. I can share the rollout job id.

devon: paste rollout id plz. I'll check kernel/compilepath diffs and allocator stats.

anya: rollout id: rollout-2026-03-15-trt8-flashattn-42. It touched runtime-kernel:v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 on ~20% of the pool.

devon: ok reading logs. decode tail errors spiking on nodes with v3.3.0. p95 across affected hosts ~420ms (baseline ~110ms), p99 ~1.9s. Streaming stalls up ~3.5% (clients see partial streams + hangs).

sam: also see a jump in pagefaults and KV cache evictions in metrics. eviction-rate doubled on those hosts in the same time window.

devon: looking at kernel compile flags in v3.3.0:```
CFLAGS=\"-O3 -march=native -DUSE_TRT8_KERNELS -DFLASHATTN_TFMEM=1\"
```
That DUSe flag toggles a new codepath for attention fusion. suspecting it triggers larger transient memory working set -> more paging/evictions.

kevin: can we confirm with heap/pagemap from one affected host? any io stall logs?

devon: grabbing vmstat/iostat now. here's a snippet from host-az2-12:```
vmstat 1 5
procs -----------memory---------- ---swap-- -----io---- -system-- ------cpu-----
 r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st
 2  1  1048576  512000  10240  204800   0   128  18000  23000 800 1200 45 10 40 5 0
```
notable: high bi/bo and swap activity coincident with spikes.

anya: oh damn. that matches the rollback window for rollout-2026-03-15-trt8-flashattn-42 when traffic shifted.

devon: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout and roll back runtime-kernel on the subset 2) temporarily route streaming requests in eu-west-1 to fallback variant (less aggressive kernel path) 3) scale-up instances to reduce per-host working set pressure 4) create a hotpatch to disable FLASHATTN_TFMEM quick flag if rollback not possible.

deploy-bot: rollpause: rollout-2026-03-15-trt8-flashattn-42 paused by @devon at 2026-03-15T09:38:12Z.

devon: executing rollback to v3.2.1 for the affected ASG now. running `kubectl set image` on runtime pods + draining nodes with v3.3.0. will keep traffic steering in place.

kevin: copy. I'll take the overnight handoff if this isn't fully mitigated in 30m. please add action items.

devon: current status: rollback job started, 6/18 nodes rolled back so far. p95 dropped to ~160ms on rolled nodes, overall region p95 down to 260ms (still elevated vs baseline). p99 trending down.

anya: customer impact: partial streaming stalls reported for 3 customers (eu-enterprise-1, chatflow-inc, streamerly). CS notified. we should prepare incident severity update.

sam: adding quick runbook note: likely root cause is new attention kernel memory allocation profile under -DUSE_TRT8_KERNELS causing transient large working set + KV cache pressure -> page faults on GPU/host -> tail latency. Follow-ups: independent repro test with perf harness, memory instrumentation in kernel, and revert flag in compile-time matrix.

devon: agreed. If rollback completes cleanly and p95/p99 return to normal, we'll transition to postmortem. If not, we'll hotpatch flag disable tomorrow AM. @kevin you own post-rollback verification and customer comms if I'm offline.

kevin: got it. will monitor p95/p99 and customer tickets. leaving note for eng-runtime to add a canary that measures eviction rate post-compile-change.

devon: final note before handoff: timeline + actions to include in incident update:```
- 09:12 UTC: rollout started (rollout-2026-03-15-trt8-flashattn-42)
- 09:30 UTC: incident-bot p95 alert (>350ms)
- 09:33 UTC: triage + identify kernel flags
- 09:38 UTC: rollout paused
- 09:40 UTC: rollback to v3.2.1 initiated
- 09:50 UTC: partial recovery on rolled nodes (p95 -> ~160ms)
- next: complete rollback + monitor + postmortem
```

incident-bot: Incident severity: S3 -> elevated customer impact (partial streaming stalls). Next update in 20m or on status change.

kevin: taking over. tagging eng-runtime & eng-ml for root cause analysis. will update in thread. :thumbsup:
